source_doc.title: Sivers & GlobalFoundries advance AI data center optical solutions (Semiconductor Today, June 2, 2026)
source_doc.permission_basis: Third-party trade publication (Semiconductor Today, Juno Publishing and Media Solutions Ltd); copyrighted editorial. Repository retains only the canonical URL, limited verbatim excerpts needed for evidence, and derived research — not the full article text.

sources.quote: Sivers' laser arrays will be integrated into reference designs built on GF's silicon photonics platform
The laser arrays will also be available in GF's Silicon Photonics Co-packaged Advanced Light Engine (SCALE) platform

nodes.name: GF Silicon Photonics Co-packaged Advanced Light Engine (SCALE™)

claims.statement: Independent trade-press (Semiconductor Today) confirmation, dated 2026-06-02, that Sivers laser arrays will be integrated into GlobalFoundries silicon photonics reference designs and available in the SCALE co-packaged light engine platform — a non-Sivers origin corroborating the Sivers-GF supply relationship.
claims.disproof_condition: If GF publicly names an alternative primary laser-array supplier for its silicon photonics reference designs / SCALE platform, or the collaboration lapses without design wins within 12-18 months, downgrade.
